summary.text: Frank Pafko is the Republican candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 51A in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Michael Howard.
He was previously the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House in 2018 and 2020 and for the Minnesota State Senate in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Frank Pafko was the Republican nominee for Minnesota House of Representatives District 63B in 2018, when Jean Wagenius defeated him, and again in 2020, when Emma Greenman defeated him.
In 2022, he was the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 51, which Melissa Halvorson Wiklund won with 69.6 percent of the vote to his 30.2 percent.
